INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR AGREEMENT, EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK POLICY, SEVERANCE AGREEMENT AND BACKGROUND CHECK DISCLOSURE

These instruments govern the engagement of the individual identified on the signature page (the "Contractor", also the "Employee") by Ridgeline Services Inc. (the "Company").

1. Engagement and Classification

1.1 The Contractor is engaged as an independent contractor and is not an employee of the Company.

1.2 The Contractor shall work from the Company's premises from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, and shall record arrival and departure in the Company's timekeeping system.

1.3 The Company shall provide the Contractor with a Company laptop, a Company email address and all other equipment necessary for the engagement.

1.4 The Contractor shall report daily to the Contractor's supervisor and shall follow the supervisor's direction as to the manner and means of performing the work.

1.5 The Contractor shall not perform services for any other client during the term of this Agreement.

1.6 The Contractor shall be eligible for the Company's paid vacation, holiday and health benefits on the same basis as the Company's employees.

2. Non-Competition

2.1 For twenty-four months after termination, the Employee shall not compete with the Company or engage in any competing business anywhere in the United States.

3. Training Repayment

3.1 The Company shall provide the Contractor with training at the Company's expense. If the Contractor terminates the engagement within thirty-six (36) months of completing the training, the Contractor shall repay the Company the full cost of the training, together with the signing bonus paid to the Contractor.

4. Confidentiality and Conduct

4.1 The Employee shall not discuss or disclose the Employee's wages, salary, bonus, benefits or other terms and conditions of employment with any other employee, any former employee or any third party.

4.2 The Employee shall not make any statement, whether on social media or otherwise, that is critical of the Company, its management, its working conditions or its compensation practices.

5. Social Media Policy

5.1 Employees shall not post about the Company, their pay, their hours or their working conditions on any social medium, blog, forum or review site.

6. Severance Agreement

6.1 In consideration of the severance payment, the Employee shall keep the existence and terms of this Agreement strictly confidential and shall not disparage the Company, its officers, its directors or its employees to any person. This Agreement is offered to the Employee, who is not a supervisor within the meaning of the National Labor Relations Act.

7. Background Check Disclosure

7.1 The Company may obtain a consumer report about the Employee from a consumer reporting agency for employment purposes.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed these instruments.

RIDGELINE SERVICES INC.
